verdict.rationale: OpenCode is an AI coding agent that takes natural-language prompts. The docs cover asking it to fix an issue, which it does on a new branch and submits as a PR. It also offers a plan agent and a read-only explore agent to analyze and investigate code without changing it, and loads LSPs automatically, which community users praise. Missing for 10: dedicated debugging/troubleshooting documentation (e.g., error or stack-trace diagnosis, running tests to reproduce bugs) and independent hands-on reports of debugging sessions specifically.
